 "description": "Studies information theory and selected applications for data management, machine learning, and information retrieval. Information theory examines the transmission, processing, extraction, and utilization of information. Topics include entropy; mutual information; cross-entropy; data processing theorem; information inequalities; Cox's theorem; maximum entropy solutions; and applications such as data normalization, decision trees, maximum likelihood, logistic regression, and VC dimensions. Requires prior study of standard computer science algorithms.
